defect: The fix moves the device-layer query from CreateInstance into ChooseDevice because a later refactor made it run before physical_device_ was chosen.
reason: At 033676c the device-layer query used physical_devices_[0] after enumeration and was correct; the change only downgraded errors to warnings, and the ordering bug came from the later CreateInstance/ChooseDevice split.

defect: The new duplicate check compiles the vertex shader first and, when the id is already cached, neither inserts nor deletes it, leaking the compiled shader.
reason: The fix moves CompileVertexShader inside the !vsCache_.Get(id) branch, repairing the leak path that this change's added else branch created.

defect: Re-enabling the fabsf entry with a null replaceFunc makes the interpreter's Int_Emuhack call a null function pointer when fabsf is replaced.
reason: The fix adds a C Replace_fabsf for that entry (and a null check in the interpreter); at the parent the entry was commented out, so this change put the null interpreter function back.

defect: Int_Emuhack checks the emuhack subop against 1 although EMUOP_CALL_REPLACEMENT is 2, so every replacement call trips the debug assert.
reason: The fix replaces the literal 1 with EMUOP_CALL_REPLACEMENT, which was already 2 in JitCommon.h when this change added the check.

defect: The fix only casts SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_ERRNO_FILE_ALREADY_EXISTS to int in the ternary to silence an enum-type warning.
reason: A warning cleanup with no behaviour change is not a defect repair.

defect: The fix only casts ERROR_PSMFPLAYER_NO_MORE_DATA to int in the ternaries to silence enum-type warnings.
reason: A warning cleanup with no behaviour change is not a defect repair.

defect: The fix adds Maemo support to the Qt frontend (name, no AA_X11InitThreads, MyDocs paths).
reason: Maemo is X11-based, so replacing Q_WS_X11 by Q_OS_LINUX did not change what Maemo got; the fix ports the Qt frontend to a new target.

defect: The fix stores 16-bit bone weights as u16 instead of float, repairing halved weights from the later 8-bit-weight change bf51291.
reason: This change only added the w0off/uvoff offsets, which the fix keeps; the /65535 scaling it repairs was introduced later.

defect: Switching weights to the 0..2 halved convention (16-bit /65535, floats *0.5, shader *2) left the software-transform ReadWeights reading 16-bit weights as plain floats, so software skinning gets half-size weights.
reason: The fix, titled as fixing a bug from this change, adds DEC_U16 formats read with /32768 in ReadWeights, which only changes the software path that this change broke.

defect: SimulateGamepad tests pad_buttons with bitwise OR instead of AND, so every condition is always true and the stick is always pushed.
reason: The fix replaces | with & in exactly the lines this change added.

defect: The fix lowers the PPGe init message from NOTICE_LOG to DEBUG_LOG.
reason: A logging-level tweak is not a defect repair.

defect: On underrun __AudioMix clears the tail with memset(..., remains) where remains counts s16 samples, so only half of the missing samples are zeroed and stale data is played.
reason: The fix multiplies the memset length by sizeof(s16) in the line this change added.

defect: The fix replaces 0 as the 'unresolved blend factor' sentinel with GL_INVALID_ENUM because GL_ZERO is also 0.
reason: At d0f8293 no path ever set GL_ZERO (the lookup tables have none and only GL_ONE was substituted), so the sentinel only became ambiguous when c0075d8 added the fixA/fixB == 0 -> GL_ZERO special case.

defect: The camera-inset option is shown only for SYSPROP_SYSTEMVERSION >= 29 although display-cutout insets exist from API 28, so Android 9 devices with notches never get the option.
reason: The fix lowers the version check this change added from 29 to 28 (issue #13774).

defect: The fix repairs Debug->Stop by clearing coreStatePending with a notify and stepping the loop on CORE_POWERDOWN, and deletes the duplicate UpdateRunLoop.
reason: This change only added a reason string to sleep_ms calls; the Stop regression lies in the core state handling it did not touch.

defect: check_variables casts to the non-existent type IOTimingMethod (the enum is IOTimingMethods), so the libretro core does not compile.
reason: The fix corrects that type name in the line this change added; the label rename is cosmetic.

defect: On shutdown the worker wakes with active false and still locks doneMutex, which the owning thread holds since construction, while the destructor waits in join(), so the two deadlock.
reason: The fix moves the done-notification inside if(active) in the WorkFunc this change added.

defect: The fix removes unresolved merge-conflict markers (and the empty default constructor) from atomic_flag.
reason: The conflict markers came from the merge commit 37df1f1 after this change; 5a5b02d's own atomic_flag was clean and its default constructor matched upstream.

defect: Jit_PosS16Through converts the signed X and Y positions with an unsigned FCVT (WU), so negative through-mode coordinates become huge values.
reason: The fix switches the X/Y conversions to signed W in the function this change added, whose own comment says X and Y are signed.

defect: The fix removes unresolved merge-conflict markers in OnEnableAll and OnImportCheat, keeping the HEAD side.
reason: The conflict markers were left by a later merge, not by c2732e4, whose own text had none.

defect: The fix reformats the button map, drops stale comments and an unused helper, and adds a TODO.
reason: A style and cleanup commit with no behaviour change is not a defect repair.

defect: The new NEON path assigns vreinterpret_s8_u64 (an int8x8_t) to a uint8x8_t, a type mismatch that breaks compilation on strict NEON compilers (issue #19258).
reason: The fix changes the intrinsic to vreinterpret_u8_u64 in the NEON block this change added.

defect: Splitting the single vfb loop into source and destination loops kept the 0x44000/0x88000 size-mismatch skip only in the destination loop, so the framebuffer at dst, previously skipped entirely, can now become a source candidate.
reason: The fix restores the same vfb_address == dst skip in the source loop (Brothers in Arms #18512), undoing the behaviour lost when this change split the loop.

defect: The fix uses the world-transformed normal and its length in the diffuse (and later specular) factor instead of the model normal and the world position length.
reason: The use of vertex.normal and / vertex.worldpos.Length() was already in the diffuse line before this change, which only replaced L.Length() by d and added attenuation and spot factors.

defect: The fix skips texture sampling when texture mapping is disabled and forces framebuffer alpha to 0xFF.
reason: Unconditional sampling and the alpha write predate this change, which only switched the vertex colour interpolation from float to integer values that the fix keeps.

defect: The fix makes VIRTKEY_PAUSE set pauseTrigger_ instead of pushing GamePauseScreen directly, so two pause screens are not pushed.
reason: Pushing the pause screen directly from onVKeyDown predates this change, which only chose GamePauseScreen under bNewUI, and the double push arises with later input changes.

defect: On non-Windows getLocalIp now overwrites the socket-derived localip with gethostbyname(gethostname()), which on Linux/Android typically yields a loopback address, so the local IP is detected wrongly.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added gethostbyname branch with getsockname on the server socket, getifaddrs or a UDP-connect lookup ('Fix Local IP detection on non-Windows system').

defect: The new fake sceKernelReferThreadProfiler is declared as taking a status pointer and returning 0, but the real call takes no argument and returns a pointer to a profiler register block.
reason: The fix corrects the wrapper and signature this change added (WrapI_U to WrapU_V) and returns an allocated zeroed block; the right signature is PSP API knowledge not visible in the code.

defect: The fix drops the subscribeKeyEvent forwarding in favour of NativeKey-based media key handling and fixes tabs.
reason: This is a same-day redesign of how Symbian media keys are delivered, not a repair of a demonstrated defect.

defect: Config::Save passes &bScreenshotsAsPNG (a pointer, always true) to Set instead of the bool.
reason: The address-of was already in the line before this change, which only renamed the variable.

defect: Restoring controls only deleted the controller ini without resetting the in-memory key map; the fix calls KeyMap::RestoreDefault().
reason: At c554f4e the deletion was followed by Load(), which falls back to KeyMap::RestoreDefault() when the controller ini is missing; the Load() call was removed later by 1f3779d, which broke it.

defect: The fix moves the TabHolder constructor out of line and adds a ScrollView for horizontally scrolling tabs.
reason: This is a feature (scrollable tab strip) unrelated to the removed redundant orientation_ member.

defect: ChangeStatusShutdown now always runs the threaded UtilityDialogShutdown on the accessThread, even when the dialog never started (status NONE, e.g. a savedata Init that fails), leaving a shutdown in flight that breaks a following dialog start.
reason: The fix skips the dialog-thread shutdown when the status was NONE, a path that only exists since this change replaced the plain ChangeStatus(NONE) with UtilityDialogShutdown.

defect: The fix replaces sprintf of PPSSPP_GIT_VERSION into a 256-byte buffer with snprintf and adds crash-screen info.
reason: The short version string cannot overflow 256 bytes, so this is hardening plus a feature, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix adds address checks before guest-memory writes in several sceNet stubs and a null check on the adhocctl handler before calling it.
reason: The crashing paths (unchecked WriteStruct in GetParameter, call through a null handler in Scan) were added after this change; the stub here only wrote through Memory::Write_U8, which already rejects invalid addresses without crashing.

defect: The save task creates the directory from filename.NavigateUp() (the replacement source path) instead of saveFilename.NavigateUp(), so the target folder under the new-textures directory is not created.
reason: The fix changes filename to saveFilename in the line this cleanup added when it replaced the old saveDirectory logic.

defect: The fix changes the strstr pattern from OES_texture_float to GL_OES_texture_float for consistency.
reason: Every extension string containing OES_texture_float also contains GL_OES_texture_float, so the detection result does not change.

defect: The fix stops binding and clearing the backbuffer twice while stepping on Vulkan by removing || Core_IsStepping() from the first-pass condition and reworking the stepping branch.
reason: The Core_IsStepping() clause and the stepping-branch bind predate this change, which only replaced g_Config.bSkipBufferEffects by a local and guarded the behind-path bind.

defect: createAtrac hands out IDs from a u8 counter that only increments, with no wrap limit or check against live IDs, so after 256 creations it reuses an ID still in atracMap, overwriting and leaking that context.
reason: The fix replaces nextAtracID++ with a loop that wraps at 0x3f and skips IDs already in use.

defect: The NEON LoadConvertS8 calls vmovl_s16 on the int8x8_t value instead of the widened value16, which is a type error and the wrong conversion.
reason: The fix changes vmovl_s16(value) to vmovl_s16(value16) in the function this change added (the other FromVec4S32 repair concerns code added later).
